assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, FAR, height, density, setbacks and building control lines are not present in the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: All intensity and form guidance is conceptual; no value is presented as an approved control.

assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry.
assumptions.impact: They support intake generation and topology checks only. Every design layer, metric, figure, PDF and HTML view must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, intersection geometry, transit entrances and cross-sections are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Proofline and east-west links are conceptual connections, not engineering alignments.

assumptions.statement: Parcel, ownership and implementation boundaries are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Project areas and retain-repair-insert-replace actions are planning prototypes, not parcel decisions.

assumptions.statement: Cleared existing building footprints, uses, heights, age and structural condition are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Submitted building polygons are concept prototypes and cannot support demolition, retention or capacity conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection and construction-control zones for the railway park and historic assets are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks remain low-impact, reversible concepts until heritage review is complete.

assumptions.statement: Municipal utilities, fire access, flood, drainage, energy and structural conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Edge compute, energy and blue-green actions are system suggestions, not engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: A cleared inventory and capacity baseline for public services is unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Service scenarios keep human and offline channels and require a verified facility inventory before deployment.

assumptions.statement: Every public AI scenario must disclose purpose, minimize data, allow opt-out, explain results, provide human review and support rollback.
assumptions.impact: Failure of any gate stops public trial and returns the scenario to a controlled sandbox.
